dct_title_s: Systema solare et planetarium ex hypothesi copernicana secundum elegantissimas illustrissimi quondàm hugenij deductiones novissime collectum & exhibitum
dct_description_sm: Orbits of planets (Mercury - Saturn) within circle of zodiac figures and named months.  Outside this circle are various vignettes with text, including comparison of "Systema Ptolemaei", "Systema Tychonis" and "Systems Copernici" (bottom right); "Magnitudines corporum planetariorum respectu solis geometrice exhibitae" (top left); "Solis eclipsis" (lower left).
Inset: Polar projection showing California as an island with slightly indented northern coastline.  This map is identical to that on title page of Grosser atlas, 1737.
Title across sheet top on ribbon.

Probably issued in his Grosser atlas über die gantze wie diese sowol, nach Göttlicher allweisen schöpssung aus den heutigen grundsätzen der berühmtesten astronomorum Nicolai Copernici und Tychonis de Brahe, ... 1737.
State 2 - With added "Cum Privilegio Sac. Caes. Majestatis." following imprint statement, with title banner. "XII." at bottom center, below border.

State 3 -  "a Iohanne Bapt Homanno Noribergae. Cum Privilegio Sac. Caes. Maj." within title banner.  With "2"  at top right, above border. Text used for name of months is now solid with "u" as "v". Text in top right paragraph is altered. "Capricorn(v)s" is now inside the neatline. Issued in: Atlas coelestis in quo mundus spectabilis et in eodem stellarum omnium phoenomena notabilia, circa ipsarum lumen, figuram, faciem, motum, eclipses, occultationes transitus, magnitudines distantias, aliaque secundum Nic. Copernici et ex parte Tychonis de Brahe Hipothesin ... . -- Norimberae, Sumptibus Heredum Homannianorum, A. 1742.
McLaughlin map number C6-01, C6-02, C6-03.
